_meta.scope: battle loop only (title card, Bannerlord objective and host names, module result footer, result card, battle notices). Tray, About, install check and settings dialogs stay hard-coded English.
_meta.placeholders: {name} plain; {name|cap} first letter upper; {name|lower} first letter lower; {name|de} French 'de X' / d'X before a vowel (any language may use it).
